instruction: Adjust the GRUB settings so the default boot timeout is set to 10 seconds.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because modifying GRUB configuration requires editing /etc/default/grub and running update-grub with root privileges. The OSWorld environment does not provide the necessary system-level access to modify bootloader settings, making this task impossible to complete.
